basic_profile.bio: I'm a curious newcomer to the world of Reddit, just exploring the depths of this vast community. I'm based in Seattle, where I work as a freelance graphic designer, often pulling late hours which is when I browse Reddit the most. I have a keen interest in current events and technology, but I also enjoy humorous content and casual discussions. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or experimenting with new recipes. I'm not too familiar with Reddit's rules yet and sometimes find myself surprised by the vastness of the platform.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design which I studied in college, and I stay updated on tech trends through online courses and forums. My knowledge is mostly self-taught and driven by a passion for learning.
